article_title: Simulator training and residents' first laparoscopic hysterectomy: a randomized controlled trial.
citation: Jokinen Ewa, Mikkola Tomi S., Härkki Päivi. (2020). Simulator training and residents’ first laparoscopic hysterectomy: a randomized controlled trial. Surgical Endoscopy. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00464-019-07270-3
title: LH-OSATS: a procedure-specific OSATS form for laparoscopic hysterectomy with construct validity evidence
description: The LH-OSATS is an OSATS form the authors developed for laparoscopic hysterectomy, scoring 7–35 across "seven operational core steps including exposure, division of adnexa, division of round ligaments, opening of vesico-uterine and vesico-vaginal space, division of utero-sacral ligaments and posterior leaflets of board ligaments, division of uterine pedicles, and hemostasis and final inspection". In a construct validation study of 27 recorded hysterectomies (nine each by residents, young specialists and experts), scores differed between groups (p = 0.01), with residents scoring significantly lower than young specialists. The authors showed construct validity for investigational purposes but state full validation would require further studies.
requirements: Blinded assessors with mutual understanding of the form's use before assessment
constraints: The authors state full validation and routine use would require further studies with other aspects of validity and cost implications
target_learning_goals: assessing technical skill in laparoscopic hysterectomy
examples: Construct validation used 27 recorded laparoscopic hysterectomies, nine each by residents, young specialists and experts, scored by two blinded authors
